user.title: Connect to Provident
user.description: Sign in to the Provident (MeterConnex) utility portal to read your electricity, water, heating, cooling, and gas meters.

data_description.backfill_days: Days of hourly usage to import into the Energy dashboard.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Provident
reconfigure.description: Change the account credentials used to reach the Provident portal, or how far back hourly usage is imported. A larger value imports the older days on the next update.

data_description.backfill_days: Days of hourly usage to import into the Energy dashboard.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Provident
reauth_confirm.description: The stored password for account {username} no longer works. Enter the new password.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Provident portal.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Provident account is already configured.

init.title: Provident rates
init.description: Price your electricity with the rates Provident publishes for your building. The cost covers energy and, optionally, Provident's administration and meter fees; it excludes delivery, regulatory charges, rebates, and HST.

data_description.rate_plan: The plan on your Provident bill. Separate On-Peak/Mid-Peak/Off-Peak lines mean Time-of-Use; one rate that changes monthly means Market price. Changing it re-prices the imported cost history.
data_description.include_fees: Spread the monthly administration and meter fees evenly over every hour.

billed_rates.title: Rates from your bills

data_description.start: The first reading date on the bill ("Previous" reading date). Re-entering a date corrects that bill's rate.
data_description.cents: The rate on the Electricity Charge line, in cents (0.095 $/kWh is 9.5).

error.billed_rate_incomplete: Enter both the reading period start and the rate, or neither.
error.billed_rates_required: Add at least one rate from a bill.
